tiktok.caption:
Freelancer with ADHD: the task was to update one page. I redesigned the whole site 🙃

9am: just one page, my services page. Two prices and one photo. 11am: I opened the homepage and the font looked kind of off. 2pm: I was picking a new color palette for the whole site. 5pm: seven tabs of website inspo, and the services page was still untouched.

So I told FOCO about it. It broke it into four tiny steps. Step 1 was just opening the services page. Ten minutes later, it was live.

What's your version of this? 👇
Save this for the next time you start a whole redesign 📌

You don't need another to-do list. You need help starting. The app on the slides is FOCO, link in bio 💜
